claims.text: The resort overlooks a bay and a 100-metre sandy beach on Kea, a Cycladic island.

findings.quote: Overlooking one of Greece's most picturesque bays and a 100-metre sandy beach, our Cycladic Island resort reconnects guests with pure nature
Plan your visit to One&Only Kéa Island, an untapped isle off the coast of Athens.

claims.text: Kea is the closest Cycladic island to Athens.

findings.quote: Kéa is the closest Cycladic island to Athens

claims.text: Pools and windows frame Aegean views, with soaring atriums, open archways and lofty ceilings.

findings.quote: Pools and windows frame Aegean vistas; soaring atriums, open archways and lofty ceilings signal relaxed grandeur.

claims.text: The resort was designed by architect John Heah.

findings.quote: Imagined by veteran resort architect John Heah

claims.text: The stone guests see around the resort is stone found on the peninsula, excavated and repurposed.

findings.quote: each and every stone guests see is the stone found on the peninsula, excavated and repurposed to keep the area's natural materials intact

claims.text: Each villa is decorated with original art from emerging Greek artists.

findings.quote: Each is decorated with original art from emerging Greek artists

claims.text: The spa was created with the wellness brand Subtle Energies.

findings.quote: For Kea, the group worked with Subtle Energies, a wellness brand founded by Ayurveda Practitioner and Clinical Aromatherapist Farida Irani

claims.text: Bond Beach Club is a restaurant with its feet in the sand, shaded by ancient trees.

findings.quote: Bond Beach Club, a gorgeously untouched restaurant with its feet in the sand, shaded by ancient trees

claims.text: The wine list has over 200 labels, around 85% of them Greek.

findings.quote: Marouli has sourced over 200 labels, and around 85% are Greek

claims.text: The resort is pet-friendly, with pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.

findings.quote: Four-legged friends are more than welcome at our pet-friendly Greek island resort. We can cater to your canine companion with pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.

claims.text: The kids club and the Club One sports center offer a tennis court, a half basketball court and bikes for hire.

findings.quote: Tucked within the valley is an area for both the kids club (Kids Only) and the sports center (Club One)
there is a tennis court, half basketball court, games consoles, and bikes for hire

claims.text: The resort sits on its own naturally formed peninsula with panoramic views across the Aegean.

findings.quote: sits on its own naturally-formed peninsula with panoramic views across the Aegean

claims.text: Each room is a private villa suite set into the hillside, with a private courtyard entrance and its own infinity pool.

findings.quote: Each room is its own private villa suite, self-contained and set into the hillside inside its own high-ceilinged box-like free-standing structure, with private courtyard entrances and individual 26-foot infinity pools

claims.text: The spa spans three floors, with an indoor-outdoor pool, outdoor relaxation areas, and steam and sauna rooms.

findings.quote: with spaces over three floors with an indoor-outdoor pool, spacious treatment rooms, outdoor relaxation areas, and steam and sauna rooms

claims.text: Kea is surrounded by several shipwrecks, including the Britannic, sister ship to the Titanic.

findings.quote: Kea is surrounded by several shipwrecks, including that of the Britannic, the sister ship to the Titanic

claims.text: Ferry services and private transfers between Athens and Kea are not available at night.

findings.quote: ferry services and private transfers between Athens and Kéa Island are currently unavailable at night

claims.text: All transfer options are subject to weather and may be delayed or rescheduled in adverse weather.

findings.quote: All transfer options are subject to weather conditions. In the event of adverse weather, transfers may be delayed or rescheduled.
